metadata.title: Warren Buffett, Stock Market, Oil Prices | September 18 Barron’s Daily<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
The Real Reason for the Stock Market’s Surprising Strength
“Father Time always wins,” Warren Buffett said as he stepped down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway early Friday.
